# Drive Town: Dutch car theory exam guide in English

Source: https://yoloabdo.com/drive-town/guide/

Play: https://yoloabdo.com/drive-town/

Last checked: 27 October 2026

This guide explains the CBR car theory exam for a car licence (category B) in plain English. It gives the 24 rules from the Drive Town lessons and 115 Dutch exam terms with their English meaning. Read the facts first. Then practise the rules in the free Drive Town game.

Drive Town is an independent project. It is not made by or linked to CBR.

## The exam at a glance

- Questions: 50 questions that count, plus 2 test questions that do not count. Source: https://www.cbr.nl/nl/rijbewijs-halen/auto/theorie-examen-auto/hoe-gaat-het-theorie-examen-auto
- Time: 30 minutes (45 minutes with extra time or an individual exam). Source: https://www.cbr.nl/nl/rijbewijs-halen/auto/theorie-examen-auto/hoe-gaat-het-theorie-examen-auto
- To pass: At least 44 of 50 correct. Source: https://www.cbr.nl/nl/rijbewijs-halen/auto/theorie-examen-auto/hoe-gaat-het-theorie-examen-auto
- Topics: 8. Source: https://www.cbr.nl/nl/rijbewijs-halen/auto/theorie-examen-auto/onderwerpen-in-het-theorie-examen
- Question types: 6. Source: https://www.cbr.nl/nl/rijbewijs-halen/auto/theorie-examen-auto/soort-vragen-tijdens-theorie
- Animations: Some questions show a short animation without sound. Source: https://www.cbr.nl/nl/over-het-cbr/over/laatste-nieuws/nieuws/vernieuwd-theorie-examen-b-rijbewijs-vanaf-7-april
- Result: You see it at once. Source: https://www.cbr.nl/nl/rijbewijs-halen/auto/theorie-examen-auto/hoe-gaat-het-theorie-examen-auto

## What changed on 7 April 2025

Before 7 April 2025, the exam had 65 questions in three parts: hazard perception (25 questions), knowledge (12 questions) and insight (28 questions). Now the exam has 50 questions, and you get one result for the whole exam. The separate photo-based hazard-perception part is gone. Animations are now part of the questions. CBR says that the level and the content of the exam stay the same.

Source: [CBR: Vernieuwd theorie-examen B-rijbewijs vanaf 7 april](https://www.cbr.nl/nl/over-het-cbr/over/laatste-nieuws/nieuws/vernieuwd-theorie-examen-b-rijbewijs-vanaf-7-april)

## Taking the exam in English

CBR offers the car theory exam in Dutch and in English. You can also take each of them with extra time. Six terms stay in Dutch in the English exam:

- APK (vehicle test)
- autoweg (road for motor vehicles)
- brommobiel
- erf
- snorfiets (light moped)
- speed pedelec

For another language, you book and pay an official interpreter yourself. Do this at least 14 days before the exam.

Sources: [CBR: Welk theorie-examen voor de auto past bij jou?](https://www.cbr.nl/nl/rijbewijs-halen/auto/theorie-examen-auto/welk-theorie-examen-past-bij-jou); [CBR: Theorie-examenplan voor de auto](https://www.cbr.nl/nl/service/nl/nl/theorie-examenplan-auto)

## Age, booking, price and validity

- Age: You can take the theory exam from age 16. You can take driving lessons from age 16.5 and the practical exam from age 17. Source: [Rijksoverheid: Hoe oud moet ik zijn voor ik rijles mag nemen en rijexamen mag doen voor mijn autorijbewijs?](https://www.rijksoverheid.nl/onderwerpen/rijbewijs/vraag-en-antwoord/wanneer-mag-ik-rijles-nemen-en-rijexamen-doen-voor-mijn-autorijbewijs)
- Booking: Book the exam in Mijn CBR. You log in with DigiD. Without DigiD, use the paper form. Your driving school can book the exam for you after you authorise it in Mijn CBR. Bring a valid ID to the exam. Source: [CBR: Je theorie-examen auto aanvragen](https://www.cbr.nl/nl/rijbewijs-halen/auto/theorie-examen-auto/je-theorie-examen-auto-aanvragen)
- Price: In 2026, the exam costs EUR 50.50 in Dutch and EUR 57.00 in English. Extra time costs EUR 13.50 more. CBR has announced the 2027 prices: EUR 52.20 in Dutch and EUR 59.00 in English, subject to change. Sources: [CBR: Tarieven 2026](https://www.cbr.nl/nl/service/nl/nl/tarieven-2026); [CBR: Tarieven 2027](https://www.cbr.nl/nl/service/nl/artikel/tarieven-2027)
- Validity: Your practical exam must be within 1.5 years of your theory pass. Check the date in Mijn CBR. Source: [wetten.overheid.nl: Reglement rijbewijzen, artikel 67d](https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0008074/)

## The 8 exam topics

The topic names come from CBR (in Dutch). CBR does not give a number of questions for each topic. The numbers show the questions of the Drive Town practice bank: 193 in total.

- Gebruik van de weg (Road use): 36 questions
- Voorrang en voor laten gaan (Priority): 38 questions
- Bijzondere wegen, weggedeelten, weggebruikers en manoeuvres (Special roads and manoeuvres): 37 questions
- Veilig rijden met het voertuig en reageren in noodsituaties (Safe driving and emergencies): 12 questions
- Verkeerstekens en aanwijzingen (Signs and instructions): 40 questions
- Verantwoorde verkeersdeelname en milieubewust rijden (Responsible and economical driving): 14 questions
- Wetgeving (Law): 8 questions
- Voertuigkennis (Vehicle knowledge): 8 questions
- Total: 193 questions

Sources: [CBR: Onderwerpen en onderdelen van het theorie-examen](https://www.cbr.nl/nl/rijbewijs-halen/auto/theorie-examen-auto/onderwerpen-in-het-theorie-examen); [CBR: Theorie-examenplan voor de auto](https://www.cbr.nl/nl/service/nl/nl/theorie-examenplan-auto)

## 24 rules to know, in 7 chapters

Each Drive Town lesson practises one rule. The reference gives the article of the RVV 1990 (the Dutch traffic rules) or another source.

### Chapter 01: Bakery run

#### A gentle start

- Rule: A posted speed limit is a maximum. Choose a lower speed when the situation calls for it.
- Reference: RVV 1990 · Article 62 / sign A1 (https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0004825/2026-07-01#HoofdstukIII_Paragraaf1_Artikel62)
- Dutch terms: maximumsnelheid = maximum speed; bebouwde kom = built-up area

#### Someone on your right

- Rule: At an equal-priority junction, yield to drivers approaching from your right. Signs and specific exceptions can change this.
- Reference: RVV 1990 · Article 15 (https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0004825/2026-07-01#HoofdstukII_Paragraaf5_Artikel15)
- Dutch terms: voorrang = priority (right of way); kruispunt = junction

#### People come first

- Rule: Let pedestrians who are crossing, or clearly about to cross, a zebra crossing go first.
- Reference: RVV 1990 · Article 49 (https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0004825/2026-07-01#HoofdstukII_Paragraaf19_Artikel49)
- Dutch terms: zebrapad = zebra crossing; voor laten gaan = let go first

#### One last look

- Rule: When turning, yield to traffic continuing on the same road beside or close behind you. Indicate your turn.
- Reference: RVV 1990 · Articles 18 and 55 (https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0004825/2026-07-01#HoofdstukII_Paragraaf7_Artikel18)
- Dutch terms: afslaan = turn; richtingaanwijzer = indicator; voor laten gaan = let go first

#### Made it to the bakery

- Rule: During a special manoeuvre such as parking, yield to all other traffic.
- Reference: RVV 1990 · Article 54 (https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0004825/2026-07-01#HoofdstukII_Paragraaf24_Artikel54)
- Dutch terms: parkeerhaven = parking bay; richtingaanwijzer = indicator

### Chapter 02: Signs & signals

#### A light to listen to

- Rule: Red means stop. Green permits you to continue; check that you can proceed safely without blocking the junction.
- Reference: RVV 1990 · Articles 68 and 14 (https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0004825/2026-07-01#HoofdstukIII_Paragraaf3_Artikel68)
- Dutch terms: verkeerslicht = traffic light; stopstreep = stop line

#### A proper full stop

- Rule: At sign B7, stop and give priority to drivers on the crossing road. Stopping alone does not give you priority.
- Reference: RVV 1990 · Article 62 / sign B7 (https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0004825/2026-07-01#Bijlage1)
- Dutch terms: stopstreep = stop line; voorrang verlenen = give way

#### The triangle has a say

- Rule: The B6 yield sign and white triangular road markings (shark teeth) require you to give priority to drivers on the crossing road. Unlike STOP, they do not always require a full stop.
- Reference: RVV 1990 · Articles 62, 80 / sign B6 (https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0004825/2026-07-01#Bijlage1)
- Dutch terms: haaientanden = shark teeth; voorrang verlenen = give way; kruispunt = junction

#### A quieter street ahead

- Rule: A1 sets the maximum speed. Reach a lower posted limit by its sign, and choose an even lower speed when conditions require it.
- Reference: RVV 1990 · Article 62 / sign A1 (https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0004825/2026-07-01#Bijlage1)
- Dutch terms: maximumsnelheid = maximum speed; bebouwde kom = built-up area

### Chapter 03: Sharing the road

#### Room for the bus

- Rule: Inside a built-up area, drivers must give a bus room to leave its stop when its indicator shows that intention. Keep checking the road before following.
- Reference: RVV 1990 · Article 56 (https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0004825/2026-07-01#HoofdstukII_Paragraaf24_Artikel56)
- Dutch terms: bushalte = bus stop; bebouwde kom = built-up area

#### One car at a time

- Rule: At F5, give priority to oncoming traffic. F6 is the blue sign granting priority over oncoming vehicles; either sign still requires a safe, clear passage.
- Reference: RVV 1990 · Article 62 / signs F5 and F6 (https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0004825/2026-07-01#Bijlage1)
- Dutch terms: tegemoetkomende bestuurders = oncoming drivers; voor laten gaan = let go first

#### Wait beyond the train

- Rule: Wait at flashing red railway lights and closed or moving barriers. Give trains priority; enter only when you can clear the whole crossing immediately.
- Reference: RVV 1990 · Articles 15a, 71 / ProRail (https://www.prorail.nl/veiligheid/overwegen/veilig-oversteken) (ProRail guidance, not law)
- Dutch terms: overweg = level crossing

### Chapter 04: Roundabouts

#### Traffic on the roundabout first

- Rule: Most Dutch roundabouts have a give-way sign and shark teeth on each entry: traffic already on the roundabout has priority. Without signs or markings, the general rule applies and traffic from the right goes first.
- Reference: RVV 1990 · Articles 15, 62 and 80 / signs B6 and D1 (https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0004825/2026-07-01#Bijlage1)
- Dutch terms: rotonde = roundabout; haaientanden = shark teeth; voorrang verlenen = give way

#### Say where you are going

- Rule: Leaving a roundabout is a change of direction: signal right in good time before you exit. Going straight on, no signal is needed on entry.
- Reference: RVV 1990 · Article 55 (https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0004825/2026-07-01#HoofdstukII_Paragraaf24_Artikel55)
- Dutch terms: rotonde = roundabout; richtingaanwijzer = indicator

#### Cyclists around the roundabout

- Rule: A cycle path close around a roundabout counts as part of it: drivers leaving give way to cyclists on it. Shark teeth or signs on the cycle path can change this, so read them.
- Reference: RVV 1990 · Articles 18 and 55 · ANWB roundabout guidance (https://www.anwb.nl/verkeer/veiligheid/verkeersregels/rotondes) (ANWB guidance, not law)
- Dutch terms: rotonde = roundabout; fietspad = cycle path; voorrang verlenen = give way

### Chapter 05: Merging

#### Take turns

- Rule: When two lanes become one, drivers in the ending lane drive on and merge near the end. A driver in the continuing lane may let one car in. This is courtesy, not a duty of the law. The CBR examiner expects you to give merging traffic the chance when a road narrows. The driver who changes lane lets other traffic go first (Article 54).
- Reference: RVV 1990 · Articles 54, 55 and 77 (https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0004825/2026-07-01#HoofdstukII_Paragraaf24_Artikel54)
- Dutch terms: ritsen = zipper merge; einde rijstrook = end of lane; voor laten gaan = let go first

#### Join the road

- Rule: Traffic on the main road goes first. Use the lane to match its speed. Signal, then merge in one smooth move. To merge before the lane ends is a safe-driving habit from the CBR driving procedure, not an article.
- Reference: RVV 1990 · Articles 1, 54 and 55 (https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0004825/2026-07-01#HoofdstukII_Paragraaf24_Artikel54)
- Dutch terms: invoegstrook = acceleration lane; invoegen = merge; voor laten gaan = let go first

#### Make room

- Rule: A merging driver lets you go first (Article 54). A careful driver still slows down early to help a merger who cannot merge. This is a safe-driving habit, not a rule of the law. If the driver can merge, keep your lane and speed.
- Reference: RVV 1990 · Article 54 (https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0004825/2026-07-01#HoofdstukII_Paragraaf24_Artikel54)
- Dutch terms: invoegstrook = acceleration lane; voor laten gaan = let go first

### Chapter 06: Lights & sirens

#### The light turns amber

- Rule: Amber means stop, unless you can no longer stop in a safe way. The law word is redelijkerwijs: in a reasonable way. Your speed and the distance to the stop line decide this.
- Reference: RVV 1990 · Article 68 (https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0004825/2026-07-01#HoofdstukIII_Paragraaf3_Artikel68)
- Dutch terms: geel licht = amber light; verkeerslicht = traffic light; stopstreep = stop line

#### Make way

- Rule: A priority vehicle uses a blue flashing light and a two-tone horn. All road users let its driver go first (Article 50). Article 50 names no exception for a green light.
- Reference: RVV 1990 · Article 50 (https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0004825/2026-07-01#HoofdstukII_Paragraaf20_Artikel50)
- Dutch terms: voorrangsvoertuig = priority vehicle; voor laten gaan = let go first; tweetonige hoorn = two-tone horn

#### Who ranks first?

- Rule: An instruction from a police officer ranks above signs, lights and rules (Articles 82 and 84). A traffic light ranks above a priority sign (Article 64).
- Reference: RVV 1990 · Articles 64, 82 and 84 (https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0004825/2026-07-01#HoofdstukIV_Paragraaf2_Artikel84)
- Dutch terms: aanwijzing = instruction; rangorde = order of rank; verkeerslicht = traffic light

### Chapter 07: Trams & bikes

#### Trams and passengers

- Rule: A tram has priority at a junction. You give way to it, also when it comes from the left (Article 15). When a tram stands at a stop, give the passengers the chance to get on and off (Article 52). You may pass a tram on the right (Article 11).
- Reference: RVV 1990 · Articles 15 and 52 (https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0004825/2026-07-01#HoofdstukII_Paragraaf22_Artikel52)
- Dutch terms: tram = tram; tramhalte = tram stop; voorrang verlenen = give way

#### Cyclists and the strip

- Rule: A cycle strip with a solid line is for cyclists, light mopeds and disabled-person vehicles (Article 10 paragraph 2 and Article 2b). Do not let your car stand still on a cycle strip (Article 23). Two cyclists may ride side by side (Article 3 paragraph 2). A snorfiets may not.
- Reference: RVV 1990 · Articles 10 and 23 (https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0004825/2026-07-01#HoofdstukII_Paragraaf1_Artikel10)
- Dutch terms: fietsstrook = cycle strip; bromfiets = moped; snorfiets = light moped

#### Overtaking

- Rule: Overtake on the left (Article 11). Do not overtake just before or on a zebra crossing (Article 12). Do not cross a solid line between lanes (Article 76 paragraph 1). A broken line on your side may be crossed (Article 76 paragraph 2 part b). Be able to stop within the distance that is free (Article 19). An oncoming car takes that distance. Show your indicator before you move out (Article 55). Sign F1 bans motor vehicles from passing each other. A cyclist is not a motor vehicle, so you may pass it if the other rules allow.
- Reference: RVV 1990 · Articles 11, 12, 19, 55 and 76 (https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0004825/2026-07-01#HoofdstukII_Paragraaf2_Artikel12)
- Dutch terms: inhalen = overtake; doorgetrokken streep = solid line; zebrapad = zebra crossing

## Hazard practice (former CBR format)

Drive Town has 61 short hazard clips. One hazard test shows 25 of them. For each clip, you choose Brake, Release accelerator or Do nothing.

The clips follow the format of the former CBR hazard-perception part (gevaarherkenning), which CBR used until 6 April 2025. They are original 3D scenes, not CBR material. The exam today has no separate hazard part, but the animation questions also test what you expect to happen next.

## How to practise with Drive Town

- Guided mode gives you prompts from a driving coach. Independent mode changes the traffic timing and gives no safety prompts until you ask for a hint.
- The mock exam has 50 questions in 30 minutes, with a pass at 44. It uses 193 original questions of 6 question types.
- The result shows your weak topics. Choose "Practise lessons" to practise the lessons of a weak topic, or "Drill: 10 questions" to drill one topic.
- Your progress stays only in your browser.
- The questions are original. They are not CBR exam questions.
- A practice result does not predict your result in the real exam.

Play Drive Town: https://yoloabdo.com/drive-town/

## Frequently asked questions

### Can I take the Dutch car theory exam in English?

Yes. CBR offers the car theory exam in English, with the same 30 minutes. Six terms stay in Dutch: APK, autoweg, brommobiel, erf, snorfiets and speed pedelec. For other languages, you book an official interpreter yourself.

Sources: [CBR: Welk theorie-examen voor de auto past bij jou?](https://www.cbr.nl/nl/rijbewijs-halen/auto/theorie-examen-auto/welk-theorie-examen-past-bij-jou); [CBR: Theorie-examenplan voor de auto](https://www.cbr.nl/nl/service/nl/nl/theorie-examenplan-auto)

### How many questions are there, and how many must I get right?

The exam has 50 questions that count, plus 2 test questions that do not count. You have 30 minutes. You must answer at least 44 correctly.

Source: [CBR: Hoe gaat het theorie-examen auto?](https://www.cbr.nl/nl/rijbewijs-halen/auto/theorie-examen-auto/hoe-gaat-het-theorie-examen-auto)

### Is there still a separate hazard perception test?

No. Since 7 April 2025, the separate photo-based part is gone. Some questions show a short animation without sound, and you get one result for the whole exam.

Source: [CBR: Vernieuwd theorie-examen B-rijbewijs vanaf 7 april](https://www.cbr.nl/nl/over-het-cbr/over/laatste-nieuws/nieuws/vernieuwd-theorie-examen-b-rijbewijs-vanaf-7-april)

### How much does the theory exam cost?

In 2026, the exam costs EUR 50.50 in Dutch and EUR 57.00 in English. CBR has announced EUR 52.20 and EUR 59.00 for 2027, subject to change.

Sources: [CBR: Tarieven 2026](https://www.cbr.nl/nl/service/nl/nl/tarieven-2026); [CBR: Tarieven 2027](https://www.cbr.nl/nl/service/nl/artikel/tarieven-2027)

### How old must I be?

You can take the theory exam from age 16.

Source: [Rijksoverheid: Hoe oud moet ik zijn voor ik rijles mag nemen en rijexamen mag doen voor mijn autorijbewijs?](https://www.rijksoverheid.nl/onderwerpen/rijbewijs/vraag-en-antwoord/wanneer-mag-ik-rijles-nemen-en-rijexamen-doen-voor-mijn-autorijbewijs)

### How long is a theory pass valid?

Your practical exam must be within 1.5 years of your theory pass. Check the date in Mijn CBR.

Source: [wetten.overheid.nl: Reglement rijbewijzen, artikel 67d](https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0008074/)

### How do I book the exam?

Log in to Mijn CBR with DigiD. Without DigiD, use the paper form. Your driving school can book it after you authorise it in Mijn CBR. Bring a valid ID.

Source: [CBR: Je theorie-examen auto aanvragen](https://www.cbr.nl/nl/rijbewijs-halen/auto/theorie-examen-auto/je-theorie-examen-auto-aanvragen)

### Does CBR give free practice questions?

CBR shows sample questions on its website, in Dutch only, and does not sell theory books. Drive Town is a free practice game with original questions.

Source: [CBR: Zo leer en oefen je voor je theorie-examen](https://www.cbr.nl/nl/rijbewijs-halen/auto/theorie-examen-auto/leren-en-oefenen)
